CommunityApplications.Profile: Docker apps for Unraid by GeorgeK. qBittorrent + Private Internet Access VPN: qBittorrent behind a WireGuard or OpenVPN tunnel with a kill switch, port forwarding and automatic recovery, built on Alpine Linux for amd64 and arm64 (https://github.com/GeorgeAL78/pia-qbittorrent-docker). NetLens: a self-hosted dashboard for UniFi networks with per-device and per-app traffic, Wi-Fi and access point health, and security events; not affiliated with Ubiquiti (https://github.com/GeorgeAL78/netlens).
